pack.title: Mogul Money: TikTokers
pack.description: A full show adapted from the Mogul Money episode with Wardrobe, Katie B and Joe Bart: ten board categories, a TikTok category for Final Trivia and the five Fast Money surveys. Questions are paraphrased. A few answers are US-specific or were only true when the episode was recorded; the host notes say which. Survey numbers are the show's where revealed and illustrative otherwise.
pack.author: Adapted from Mogul Money

categories.title: UNC
categories.blurb: People who made it to 100, or very nearly.

clues.question: Which late comedian and entertainer, who lived to 100, had Burbank Airport named after him from 2003 to 2017?
Which 39th president of the United States became the longest-lived president in American history, reaching the age of 100?
clues.notes: He died in December 2024. A Red Bull Boost on the show: the contestant said Bill Clinton.

clues.question: To how many years of age did Jeanne Calment, the person with the longest verified human lifespan, live?
clues.notes: 122 years and 164 days. She died in France in 1997.

clues.question: When this episode was recorded, how many of the world's ten oldest living people were men?
clues.notes: The show's figure at the time of recording. The list changes often, but it is rarely anything else.

clues.question: Which American actress and comedian died just weeks before her 100th birthday?
clues.notes: She died on 31 December 2021, 17 days short of 100.

categories.title: Mobile App Classics
categories.blurb: Name the classic mobile game from its description.

clues.question: In which mobile game do you launch furious birds from a slingshot to knock down structures?
In which mobile game do you guide a small four-legged alien upwards by bouncing between platforms drawn on graph paper?
Which popular mobile game has players slice fruit by swiping across the screen?
Which endless-running mobile game has you sprinting through dangerous ancient ruins while dodging obstacles?
Which mobile strategy game of collectible cards and real-time battles had a revival when the streamer Jynxzi picked it up again?
clues.notes: Not Clash of Clans, which has no cards.

categories.title: Quick Maffs
categories.blurb: Sums you can do in your head. Probably.

clues.question: You order 12 boxes of doughnuts with 12 doughnuts in each box. How many doughnuts do you get?
How much is a 20% tip on an $80 restaurant bill?
What is the mean of 10, 20 and 60?
What do the three interior angles of a triangle on a flat plane add up to?
A livestream starts with 50 viewers and doubles its audience every hour. How many viewers does it have after three hours?

categories.title: Words in Streamer Games
categories.blurb: Every answer can be spelled with letters from "streamer games".

clues.question: What is the base unit of length in the metric system?
What thick, oily substance is formed from the fat released when meat cooks?
What is molten rock called while it is still beneath the Earth's surface?
clues.notes: Not lava, which is what it becomes once it reaches the surface.

clues.question: What do you call the combining of two or more companies into one organisation?
What is a mature reproductive cell, such as a sperm or an egg, that carries half the usual genetic information?

categories.title: Go for Gold
categories.blurb: The Olympic Games, past and upcoming.

clues.question: Which US city will host the 2028 Summer Olympic Games?
Which American swimmer has won more Olympic medals than anyone else in history?
clues.notes: 28 medals, 23 of them gold.

clues.question: Which Olympic endurance event is associated with the ancient Greek messenger Pheidippides?
Which American figure skater won two gold medals at the 2026 Winter Olympics, in the women's singles and the team event?
clues.notes: Reworded from the show's clue, whose exact claim was unclear in the captions.

clues.question: Name one of the two sports making their Olympic debut at the 2028 Los Angeles Games.
clues.notes: Either one is enough. Cricket, lacrosse and baseball/softball are returning, not debuting.

categories.title: High School Trivia
categories.blurb: Things you were taught once, in an American classroom.

clues.question: Which cell organelle is commonly called the powerhouse of the cell?
Which 1925 novel by F. Scott Fitzgerald features Jay Gatsby and Daisy Buchanan?
The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria in 1914 helped to trigger which major conflict?
Which landmark 1973 decision of the US Supreme Court recognised a constitutional right to abortion?
clues.notes: Overturned by the Supreme Court in 2022.

clues.question: Which trigonometric function is worked out by dividing the side opposite an angle in a right-angled triangle by the hypotenuse?
clues.notes: The SOH in SOH-CAH-TOA.

categories.title: Boomer Media
categories.blurb: Formats your parents had to rewind, flip over or blow into.

clues.question: Which large, flat music discs reproduce recorded sound from a spiral groove?
clues.notes: The show's host insisted on "vinyl records" and marked plain "vinyl" wrong. Your call.

clues.question: Which portable magnetic-tape audio format was played on devices such as the Sony Walkman?
Which high-definition optical disc format arrived in 2006 as the successor to DVD?
clues.notes: HD DVD also launched in 2006 but lost the format war; host's call.

clues.question: Which Nintendo console kept using ROM cartridges while its competitors were moving to CDs?
Which home video recording format beat Betamax and dominated the 1980s and 1990s?

categories.title: Coming of Age
categories.blurb: Every answer is an age, by American rules.

clues.question: At what age can someone generally enlist in the US military without a parent's permission?
clues.notes: 17 with parental consent.

clues.question: Under US federal law, what is the usual minimum age for a non-agricultural job outside school hours?
What is the minimum age to rent a car in the United States?
clues.notes: The show accepted 20 or 21 and marked 25 wrong. It varies by company and state, and under-25s usually pay a surcharge, so judge as you see fit.

clues.question: What is the minimum age to create a Twitch account?
clues.notes: Under-18s need a parent or guardian's agreement.

clues.question: At what age do most Americans first become eligible for Medicare?

categories.title: Tik Tok
categories.blurb: Time and how we measure it. Nothing to do with the app.

clues.question: How often does a leap year usually come round in the Gregorian calendar?
clues.notes: "Usually" because century years must divide by 400: 1900 was not one, 2000 was.

clues.question: Which British term means a period of two weeks?
How many minutes are there in an ordinary 365-day year?
clues.notes: As sung in "Seasons of Love" from the musical "Rent".

clues.question: Which word means a period of 1,000 years?
What is the term for the time it takes half of the atoms in a radioactive sample to decay?

categories.title: Palindromes
categories.blurb: Every answer reads the same forwards and backwards.

clues.question: Which three-letter word describes music that is popular with mainstream audiences?
Which three-letter word completes the classic playground comeback "Your ___"?
clues.notes: The show's answer is Mom. Mum and Dad are palindromes too.

clues.question: Which five-letter word means a stage in a video game, or a degree of achievement?
Which 2020 Christopher Nolan film, starring John David Washington and Robert Pattinson, has a palindrome for a title?
Which language, whose name is a palindrome, is spoken mainly in the Indian state of Kerala?

categories.title: TikTok
categories.blurb: The show's Final Trivia category, about the app. Pick it for Final Trivia and the last clue is asked.

clues.question: What is the name of TikTok's main personalised feed, often shortened to FYP?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which Chinese technology company created TikTok?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which lip-syncing app was merged into TikTok in 2018?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which Senegalese-born Italian creator became TikTok's most-followed person with his silent, deadpan reactions to life-hack videos?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: When this episode of Mogul Money was recorded, how many TikTok accounts had more than 100 million followers?
clues.notes: The show's Final Trivia question. Its three were Khaby Lame, Charli D'Amelio and MrBeast. The count may have changed since.

surveys.question: About how many steps do you walk a day, to the nearest thousand?
Besides feet, name something that runs.
Rate McDonald's on a scale of one to five.
Name something you can buy for one dollar.
